title: MZ [Free Tool] MV & MZ Var&Switch Organizer - Track, Tag, and Find Usages!

posts.author: LCpjt
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
As my RPG Maker projects grew larger, I found myself constantly getting lost trying to remember what Switch #253 was for, or where exactly Variable #112 was being modified. Keeping everything organized was becoming a real challenge.
To solve this, I developed a standalone desktop application called
MV & MZ Var&Switch Organizer
, and I'd like to share it with the community for free.
This tool scans your RPG Maker MV or MZ project and provides a powerful interface to manage, document, and track all your switches and variables.
Key Features:
Comprehensive Tracking:
See all your Switches and Variables in one place, loaded directly from your project's data files. The list shows their ID, original name, and your custom alias
Usage Finder:
This is a huge time-saver. Instantly see every single map and common event where an element is used. No more hunting through hundreds of event pages!
Aliases and Notes:
Forget cryptic names from the database. Assign your own clear aliases (internal names) and write detailed notes for any switch or variable to remember its purpose.
Powerful Tagging System:
The core organizational feature. Create custom, color-coded tags (e.g., 'Main Quest', 'Puzzles', 'Day/Night System') to categorize your game's logic.
(Suggested Screenshot: The Tag Manager window)
[INSERT SCREENSHOT OF THE TAG MANAGER HERE]
Tags View:
A dedicated tab that groups all your elements by the tags you've assigned. This gives you a fantastic high-level overview of your game's systems.
(Suggested Screenshot: The Tags View tab showing elements grouped under tags)
[INSERT SCREENSHOT OF THE TAGS VIEW HERE]
Search and Filter:
Quickly find anything you need by its original name, your custom alias, its ID, or even by a tag name.

How to Use:
Download the .exe file from the link below.
Run the file (no installation required).
Go to File > Open Project and select your RPG Maker MV or MZ project folder.
Enjoy!
Download form itch.io
This is the first public release, so any feedback, bug reports, or feature suggestions are highly welcome! Please feel free to reply to this thread.
I hope you find it useful!
